versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 – Renamed skill and updated documentation structure.

- Skill renamed from "gzh-power-ranking" to "wechat-top-account"
- Added comprehensive English and Chinese README files
- Unified and expanded usage, authentication, and deployment instructions in SKILL.md
- Old skill-card.md removed to reduce redundancy
- Documentation now clarifies core workflow, API Key setup, and usage scenarios

- Initial release of the gzh-power-ranking skill (公众号综合实力榜).
- Provides quick access to WeChat Official Account (公众号) comprehensive power rankings (TOP50), with filtering by daily, weekly, or monthly periods and 23 domain categories.
- Offers detailed statistics including composite scores, reading/interaction metrics, and account-level deep analysis features.
- Supports exporting HTML visual reports and subscribing to scheduled leaderboard updates.
- Enforces standardized output formatting and workflow; adheres strictly to the project’s core workflow documentation.
- Designed for operations review, content benchmarking, competitive analysis, and regular reporting scenarios.
